name: Hell On Earth
storyline:
Set in a dark medieval fantasy world, you play as the Paladin an ultimate weapon forged by the Church after your parents were killed in the first war. As signs of corruption spread, villagers vanish, and monsters roam the land, you are sent to uncover the source of the growing evil. Your master, Father Bartholomew, fears a new war is imminent.
Your investigation leads you to Nezherul, Bartholomew’s former apprentice and the brightest scholar of the Order, exiled for delving into forbidden dark magic. Believing he could master both light and shadow to achieve ultimate power and bring good to the world, Nezherul instead fell to corruption. Manipulated by demon lords, he now seeks to open the Gates of Hell within his own realm.
In relentless pursuit across diverse and dangerous lands, you follow the trail of chaos Nezherul leaves behind purging his corrupted forces and restoring order before finally confronting the source of the evil itself.
summary: Hell on Earth is a fast paced action rogue-lite game, playable solo or in co-op with a friend. Battle hordes of enemies, collect gold, gems, gear, and enhance your hero to defeat powerful bosses. Choose your class, customize your hero’s skills, select your appearance, and save the world from Hell.
